title: Const-ify some structures in the DHCP, SMB, IPMI and SCSI dissectors
description: A handful of const-ification changes, which altogether move about 58 kBytes of data from a read-write section to a read-only section -- and also eliminates 1.2 kBytes of no-longer-necessary initialization code from the DHCP dissector.

notes.body:
added 6 commits
  • 6464e9a3...3696e929 - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 05b53593 - DHCP: Const-ify some option-parsing structures.
  • 100fd9f2 - SMB: Const-ify SMB{,2} function dissector tables.
  • c775c96f - IPMI: Const-ify ipmi_cmd_t instances.
  • fe16c00a - SCSI: Const-ify scsi_cdb_table_t instances.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15769/diffs?diff_id=1020085524&start_sha=6464e9a36ee3bfcb094e244df2852def32883ef0)

commits_data.title: SCSI: Const-ify scsi_cdb_table_t instances.
commits_data.message:
SCSI: Const-ify scsi_cdb_table_t instances.

Moves about 12 kBytes of data from a read-write section to a read-only section.

commits_data.title: IPMI: Const-ify ipmi_cmd_t instances.
commits_data.message:
IPMI: Const-ify ipmi_cmd_t instances.

Moves about 23.5 kBytes of data from a read-write section to a read-only
section.

commits_data.title: SMB: Const-ify SMB{,2} function dissector tables.
commits_data.message:
SMB: Const-ify SMB{,2} function dissector tables.

This moves 8.2 kBytes of data from a read-write section to a read-only section.

commits_data.title: DHCP: Const-ify some option-parsing structures.
commits_data.message:
DHCP: Const-ify some option-parsing structures.

The "basic_types_hfs", "opt_info" and "opt82_info" structures are never
written.  Const-ifying them moves about 13 kBytes of data from a read-write
section to a read-only section.  static-ifying some function-scoped arrays also
eliminates about 1.2 kBytes of unnecessary initialization code from function
entry points.
